entity.summary: Dubai-based virtual-asset exchange platform providing order-book spot trading between virtual assets and fiat currencies and between virtual assets.
entity.notes: The current first-party platform presents live account registration and crypto trading, and its trading rules describe an order-book exchange operated by LCT Global FZE. Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority lists LCT Global FZE under reference VL/25/12/001 with an active Exchange Services licence for retail, qualified, and institutional investors. No exact platform launch date is inferred from the licence issue date.

evidence.title: LCT exchange trading rules
evidence.notes: First-party rules identify LCT Global FZE as operator of the virtual-asset exchange platform and describe 24/7 order-book trading in virtual-asset/fiat and virtual-asset/virtual-asset pairs.

evidence.title: LCT Global FZE public register entry
evidence.notes: Official VARA entry identifies LCT Global FZE, official website, reference VL/25/12/001, Exchange Services activity, retail eligibility, licence issue date, and active status.
